newsitem.title: POLAND: BWR sees 1997 net up to PLN 5.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: BWR sees 1997 net up to PLN 5.7 mln.

text.p: Polish Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej SA (BWR) expects to lift its net profit to 5.7 million zlotys this year from 4.5 million in 1996, the bank said in an abbreviated version of its issue prospectus.
BWR said its revenues from interest should rise to 110.9 million zlotys from 85.2 million in 1996 and its balance sheet total was likely to rise to 828.2 million zlotys from 606.5 million last year.
From March 21 to June 20 BWR plans to issue 1,671,915 shares to four selected investors at 3.81 zlotys per share to be paid for with real estate.
